title: One of California's first counties
text: San Luis Obispo County was created in 1850 as one of California's original 27 counties. It shares its name with its county seat, the city of San Luis Obispo, and with the mission there, Mission San Luis Obispo de Tolosa. The mission was named for Saint Louis, bishop of Toulouse in France, and obispo is Spanish for bishop. When the county was new, the old mission served as its first courthouse and jail.
